rationale: A is much more useful for an actual decision-maker because it compares multiple live two-feature combinations, introduces a plausible omitted option (embed mode), gives conditional recommendations based on load-time and content type, and explicitly handles failure modes and uncertainty. Its quantitative framing is imperfect but materially helps discriminate between alternatives. B is concise and sensible, but it under-analyzes customization by partly folding it into shareability, gives limited uncertainty handling, and offers much weaker quantitative support. B would help as a quick heuristic; A would better support a careful launch decision.
